meta.title: QMap: the live map of your residential complex
meta.description: Cafés, services and shops of your residential complex on an interactive map, down to the section and entrance. Already live in Varshavskyi and Dibrova.

hero.lede: QMap shows the cafés, services and shops of your residential complex down to the section and entrance. Businesses are added in minutes, and the map updates right after moderation.

problem.questionStart: How many times have you crossed the road for coffee when
problem.questionHighlight: there was a café in your own courtyard?
problem.text: In a large complex new places open every month, move and change their hours. Residents' chats lose this information fast. QMap keeps it in one place and always up to date.

features.title: A map kept up to date by the people who live and work here
features.text: Residents find what they need. Business owners manage their own listing. A moderator makes sure only verified data reaches the map.

map.title: The whole complex at a glance
map.text: Buildings, sections, entrances and courtyard paths on one plan. Tap a pin to see the hours, contacts and the route to the right door.

add.title: A new business on the map in 1 step
add.text: An owner or admin fills in a short form: name, category, location and opening hours. A photo of the storefront helps neighbours recognise the door.
ticks: Pick building, section and entrance from a list

fresh.title: Changes reach the map right away
fresh.text: A move, new hours, a temporary closure or a seasonal offer. The owner updates the listing, a moderator approves it, residents see fresh data.

search.title: “Open now” right next to your entrance
search.text: Search by name or category. QMap shows what is open right now and sorts places by distance from your building.
ticks: Filters by category and opening hours

notify.title: Be the first to know what's new
notify.text: Get notified about new openings and changes at your favourite places. You choose the categories and can turn notifications off at any time.

items.text: Bread & Cheese Bakery has opened in bldg 4. First coffee is on the house.

items.title: QMap · Favourites

how.title: From request to a pin on the map
how.text: Every business is verified, so residents only see real places with the correct address.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: The owner fills in a form in the app: name, category, location, hours.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: A moderator checks the address and contacts and asks for details if needed.

steps.title: Publishing
steps.text: The pin appears on the map and residents get a notification.

steps.title: Updates
steps.text: The owner changes hours or status, and the map stays current.

business.title: Why your business belongs on the complex map
business.text: Your closest customers live a few minutes' walk away. QMap helps them learn you are nearby and find your exact door.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Didn't find an answer? Email us at {email}.

items.a: Yes. Browsing the map, search and notifications are free for residents. Listing a business is free too.
Right now in Varshavskyi, where we first launched, and in Dibrova. You choose your complex in the app and can change it in your profile.

items.q: How do we connect our complex?
items.a: Send a request from your homeowners' association, management company or a group of residents: email {email} or use the [support page](/support).
You can browse the map without signing up. An account is needed to add or edit a business, save favourites and report mistakes.

items.q: Who can add a business to the map?
items.a: The owner or a representative of a place that operates in the complex. A moderator reviews every request before publishing.
Only if you allow it. Location is used to show you on the map and build a route. Without permission the app works fully except for these features. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

items.q: How do I report a mistake on the map?
items.a: Open the place card and tap “Report a mistake”, or contact [support](/support).

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: In the app: Profile → Settings → Delete account. You can also send a request without signing in. See [Account deletion](/delete-account).

about.title: Who is behind QMap
about.p1: {company} develops QMap, a digital map of residential complexes. We launched in Varshavskyi, added Dibrova and are ready to connect new complexes. We help residents quickly find services near home and help local businesses get noticed by their neighbours.
about.p2: Our goal is simple: information about life in every complex should be accurate, gathered in one place and available to all residents.

blocks.text: This Policy explains what personal data the **{app}** mobile application (the “App”) and this website collect, why we process it, who we share it with and how you can control your data. It is prepared in line with the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable, and App Store and Google Play requirements.
**In short.** We collect the minimum data needed for the map to work. We do not sell personal data, do not show personalised ads and do not track you across other companies' apps or websites.
1. Who is responsible for your data

items: **Account data:** name, email address and/or phone number, password in hashed form, the residential complex you chose. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive the identifier and email that service allows.

**Business data:** place name, category, location (building, section, entrance), opening hours, contact phone, website or social links, photos. This data is published on the map and visible to all users.
**Reports:** content reports, map error reports and support requests.
**Location** (precise or approximate) only with your permission. It is used on the device to show your position on the map and build a route. We do not store your location history.
**Technical data:** device model, OS and App version, language, push notification token.
**Diagnostics:** crash and error reports to fix problems in the App.
**Usage data:** de-identified statistics on screens and features to improve the product.

blocks.text: We do not collect your address book, photos you have not selected, financial data, health data, biometrics or advertising identifiers (IDFA/AAID) for tracking.

blocks.text: We do not sell or rent personal data. Data may be shared only with:

items: **Service providers** processing data on our behalf under contract and only for the stated purposes: {processors}.
**Other users**, for public business data (name, address in the complex, hours, contacts, photos).
**Public authorities**, where required by law or a properly issued request.
**A successor** in case of reorganisation or sale of the business, with prior notice to users.

blocks.text: Some providers may store data on servers outside Ukraine. In such cases we use providers that ensure an adequate level of protection, including on the basis of standard contractual clauses.

items: Account data: while the account is active; deleted within 30 days after account deletion.
Public business data: while the listing is published or until the owner requests deletion.
Support requests and reports: up to 12 months after closing.
Diagnostics and technical logs: up to 90 days.
Data we must keep by law: for the period required by law.

blocks.text: You have the right to know what data we process; get a copy; correct inaccurate data; delete your data and account; restrict or object to processing; withdraw consent (for example, turn off location or notifications in device settings); data portability; and lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights or your local supervisory authority.
To exercise your rights, email {email}. We respond within 30 days.
You can delete your account in the App (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or send a request without signing in. Details on the [Account and data deletion](/delete-account) page.
The App is not intended for persons under {minAge}. We do not knowingly collect children's data. If you believe a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

We encrypt data in transit (TLS), store passwords only as hashes, limit staff access to data and review our safeguards regularly. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we do everything reasonably possible to protect your data.
11. Summary for App Store and Google Play
All data is encrypted in transit. Users can request data deletion.
We may update this Policy. We will notify you of material changes in the App or by email at least 14 days before they take effect. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page.

blocks.text: Every new listing and every change is reviewed by a moderator before publishing. We also use automatic filtering of profanity.

items: Open the place card on the map.
Tap “⋯” → “Report” and choose a reason.
Add a comment if needed and send.

blocks.text: You can also email {email}. We review reports within 24 hours, remove content that breaks the rules and block the author's account when necessary.
You can hide a user's content: open their listing → “⋯” → “Block author”. Their content will no longer be shown to you, and we will be notified to review it.
Depending on severity: rejection or removal of content, a warning, temporary or permanent account suspension.
This page explains how to delete your **{app}** account and associated data. Developer: {company}.

items: Open {app} and sign in.
Go to “Profile” → “Settings”.
Tap “Delete account” and confirm.

blocks.text: The account is deactivated immediately and the data is deleted within 30 days.
Send an email from the address or phone linked to your account to:
We confirm receipt within 3 business days and may ask you to confirm the account belongs to you. After confirmation the data is deleted within 30 days.

items: Account data: name, email, phone, password.
Favourite places, notification settings, push token.
Your reports and error reports (de-identified).
Business listings you created are unpublished and deleted unless transferred to another representative of that business.
Technical logs and crash reports for up to 90 days, not linked to your account.
Data we are legally required to keep, for the required period.
Backups are overwritten within 30 days.

blocks.text: Deleting some data without deleting the account
You can delete individual photos, a business listing or favourites in the app, or ask us to do it by emailing {email}.
We are here to help with anything about **{app}**, from signing in to listing a business on the map.
We reply within 1 business day. Please include your phone model, the app version (Profile → About) and a short description of the problem.

items: Install {app}, choose your complex and create an account.
On the map, tap “+ Add business”.
Fill in the name, category, building, section, entrance and hours. Add a storefront photo.
Submit for moderation. Review usually takes up to 24 hours.

blocks.text: I can't see my position on the map
Make sure the app has location access in your phone settings. Without it the map works, just without your pin.
Turn on notifications for {app} in your phone settings and in Profile → Notifications.
There is a mistake on the map
Open the place card → “Report a mistake”. We will check and fix it.
I want to delete my account
A homeowners' association, management company, developer or group of residents can send a request to {email}. Include the complex name and address and a contact person.
